import numpy as np

        ys,xs=np.where(lab==i_)
        cols=set(a[ys,xs])
        out[i_]=(tuple(sorted(zip(ys.tolist(),xs.tolist()))),sorted(cols))
    return out
cl=clusters(i2,5)
